The '''''Thranta''-class corvette,''' also known as the '''CR-12 corvette,''' was a [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] in service with the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. 

==Characteristics==
The ship class was similar in appearance to the earlier [[Praetorian-class frigate|''Praetorian''-class frigate]] and [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] models.<ref name="T2" />

The ''Thranta''-class was the workhorse of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], being produced in large numbers to compete with the ''Hammerhead''-class cruiser of the [[Jedi Civil War]] and replace the [[Praetorian-class frigate|''Praetorian''-class frigate]] of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. It was of a slightly smaller size than the [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]], but was dwarfed by the premier warship of the Republic Navy during the Great Galactic War and Cold War, the [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]]. It filled the function of a [[Corvette/Legends|Corvette]] in the Republic fleet, despite being roughly the size of a contemporary [[Cruiser/Legends|Cruiser.]]

The ''Thranta''-class Corvette possessed two main dual turbolasers mounted in the forward position, like that of the ''Hammerhead''-class, a third dual turbolaser mounted along its ventral hull, and numerous other weapons located along its hull. The armament of this ship's class was powerful enough for it to compete with the [[Gage-class transport|''Gage''-class transport]] or a [[Terminus-class destroyer|''Terminus''-class destroyer]], but it lacked the firepower to go head to head against the [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class Dreadnought]] and heavier warships. To compensate for this, they utilized their agility and pack tactics to take down larger vessels.

''Thranta''-class Corvettes possess two shielded hangars on the port and starboard sides of the ship, allowing it to hold 14 [[Liberator-class starfighter|''Liberator''-class Republic starfighters]], 3 bombers, as well as 4 shuttles.

These ships carried an entire [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of [[Republic trooper]]s and if needed a team of Jedi Knights as well as war droids and transports for reinforcements.

The ''Thranta''-class Corvette is powered by a type-4 [[Hypermatter reactor/Legends|Hypermatter annihilator]], which was powerful enough to destroy the ship and half of a fleet if the restraints keeping it stable were released.

For sublight propulsion, the ''Thranta''-class relied on a configuration of four banks of two ion engines arrayed around its aft hull, and two larger engines mounted in the center.

==History==
[[File:Thrantamandowar.png|thumb|right|270px|A Republic fleet with a ''Thranta''-class corvette or a similar-looking ship during the [[Mandalorian Wars]].]]
The ''Thranta''-class or a similar-looking design served in the Republic Navy during the onslaught of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusaders]].<ref name="T9">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 9: The Mandalorian Wars|int=Timeline 9: The Mandalorian Wars}}</ref>

Prior to the onset of the Great Galactic War, the ''Thranta''-class ships acted as peacekeeping vessels in several sectors of Republic space, dealing with disputes and pirate forces that were plaguing certain areas. ''Thranta''-class ships fought in many battles during the Great War, including the [[First Battle of Bothawui]].<ref name="Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui|int=Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui}}</ref> After the end of the war, these corvettes participated in skirmishes with [[Sith Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces. One of these skirmishes was with the ''[[Black Talon]]'', an Imperial transport ordered by Grand Moff Kilran to attack and either capture or kill "the General" aboard the Brentaal Star on route to a planetary system. Once the ''Black Talon'' attacked, aiming for the power generators, the ''[[Brentaal Star]]'' fired its turbolasers, missile launchers and several transport pods. After the ''Brentaal Star''{{'s}} boarding party was defeated, a strike team from the ''Black Talon'' boarded the Star and completed the mission. With the mission complete, the ''Black Talon'' retreated to hyperspace before incurring any damage.<ref name="DW">{{TORweb|url=media/trailers/developer-walkthrough|text=Video - Developer Walkthrough|nolive=1}}</ref>

Later in the Cold War, a single ''Thranta''-class Corvette named the [[Aurora (Valor-class)|''Aurora'']] served as the flagship for Jedi Master [[Kellian Jarro]], the final target for the Great Hunt. Many tried to kill the Jedi Master and failed until the [[Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]]'s ship was caught in the ''Aurora''{{'s}} tractor beam and brought into the hangar bay which started a battle that resulted in the death of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. This ship would later be destroyed during an explosion shortly after the schism inside of it, due to the Grand Champion disabling the ship's hyperdrive output regulator and setting the ship on a timer to jump into hyperspace. With the regulator disabled, the Aurora would be torn asunder by the forces of hyperspace.<ref name=":0">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

A number of these vessels were used in conjunction with a number of [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruisers]], under the command of Jedi Master [[Oteg]], during the [[Battle of Taral V|raid on the Imperial compound of Taral V]], intercepting the bombardment in order for the Republic strike team to recover a [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] [[Computer/Legends|computer]]. These vessels would later serve to engage Imperial forces protecting the [[Maelstrom Prison]] that held [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] for 300 years. At the end of the mission, these ships would fall back along with Oteg's flagship and the other remaining Republic vessels. After the release of Revan, Imperial forces captured a single ''Thranta''-class Corvette named the ''[[Dorin's Sky]]'' in order to pass the Republic blockade protecting the [[Foundry (space station)|Foundry]], carrying a strike team on the orders of Darth Malgus to defeat its master and to take the facility.<ref name=":0" />

[[File:Thranta-class_corvettes.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A trio of ''Thranta''-class corvettes above Manaan]]
After the onset of the [[Galactic War]], the ''Thranta''-class again saw widespread action at multiple battles including the [[Battle of Kuat (Galactic War)|Battle of Kuat]], the [[Assault on Tython]], and the [[Battle of Rishi]]. The ships were also used to transport Republic forces for many ground operations such as the [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Galactic War)|Battle of Yavin 4]] and the Invasion of Ziost, before the war was abruptly ended by the [[Eternal Empire conquest]]. At least two ''Thranta''-class class corvettes were present during the [[Destruction of Darth Marr's flagship|First skirmish with the Eternal Fleet]], and more would see action before the Republic was defeated.<ref name=":0" />

Several ''Thranta''-class corvettes were used by other organizations during the Galactic War as well, including the [[Order of Revan]] and the [[Eternal Alliance]], both of whom obtained the vessels from defected Republic officers.

After the end of the [[war against Zakuul]], ''Thranta''-class corvettes were sent by General [[Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun|Daeruun]] to [[Invasion of Ossus|secure]] the Jedi colony on Ossus at the beginning of the [[third Galactic War]].<ref name=":0" />

The ''Thranta''-class continued in service long after the last Galactic War ended, like the ''Hammerhead''-class and the ''Praetorian''-class, and was used in the Republic Navy for at least a millennium after its introduction.<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Thranta-class_corvette_TRF.jpg|thumb|right|240px|The ''Thranta''-class corvette from ''The Rebel Files''.]]
An image of a ''Thranta''-class corvette was used in the [[2018]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'' instead of the [[canon]] [[Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette|''Sphyrna''-class Hammerhead corvette]], which like the ''Thranta'' resembles the ''Hammerhead''-class cruiser.<ref name="Rebel Files">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''</ref>

The Thranta-class corvette shares a similar name to the [[Thranta-class War Cruiser|''Thranta''-class War Cruiser]] from ''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''.<ref name="X-Wing: The Bacta War">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>
